THE LAST LANTERN HAS DONE ITS WORK

The old guard bound the lich beneath this ruin and left one lantern to guide whoever came after.\n\nIts flame died when the final seal opened. Now the staff is silent, the roof gives way, and stolen morning returns to the halls.

Choose local JSON export or prepare an explicitly consented remote report. Neither happens automatically.

Remote submission sends only the note, selected basic context and optional game RT image you explicitly select through the Horde report relay for delivery to the developer email. Cloudflare verification runs in a separate WebView and does not receive your report or image. The image is captured from the game RT frame only—not an OS screenshot. No logs, saves, private files, account IDs or device serials are included. Do not enter contact details, links, private file paths or credentials. Local JSON export remains a separate choice; its document provider may sync files.
What happened, how to reproduce it, and what you expected (up to 4096 UTF-8 bytes). Your text is never silently shortened.
Describe the problem and steps to reproduce
Include basic context: product/version/build, Android model, GPU, RT backend, quality, render scale/extent and RT presentation status
I consent to exporting this note and any context I selected
I explicitly consent to sending this report to the developer through the report relay
Include selected basic context (product/build, model, GPU, RT backend, quality, extent and presentation status)
Include an optional game RT thumbnail (default maximum 768 px long edge / 432 px short edge, maximum 512 KiB; never an OS screenshot)
Review the frozen report and optional game image below. It has not been sent. Press Verify and send for a one-time Cloudflare check.
Preview of the consented game RT thumbnail, default maximum 768 px long edge / 432 px short edge and 512 KiB.
Capturing the presented game RT frame… You can cancel by editing or leaving this form.
The game frame is unavailable. Nothing was sent. Retry explicitly or edit the report.
Check remote submission consent before preparing. Nothing was sent.
Complete the one-time verification to continue. The report and image are not shown in that WebView.
Verification was cancelled. The frozen report is still ready; retry verification explicitly or edit it.
Verification did not complete. The frozen report is still ready; retry verification explicitly.
Sending this report once. Leaving or closing cannot recall a request already received by the relay.
The relay acknowledged this report as queued. This does not mean an email was sent, and the accepted report cannot be withdrawn.
The relay confirmed the report was sent to the developer. It cannot be withdrawn.

The result is uncertain: the relay may have received this report. Retry explicitly with the same report ID and bytes after fresh verification. Editing creates a different report ID and abandons same-report deduplication; an earlier accepted report cannot be withdrawn.
The frozen report is ready for fresh verification and an explicit retry. Retry keeps its report ID and bytes; an uncertain prior attempt may already have been accepted.

The prior delivery result may be uncertain. Editing creates a different report ID and abandons same-report deduplication; the previous report may already have been accepted and cannot be withdrawn. Retry the same frozen report instead, or explicitly continue editing.
This report was already accepted by the relay and cannot be withdrawn. Editing will create a separate report. Continue only if you want to send another report.
A report send has started. The relay may already have received it, and closing cannot recall it. Closing discards the same-report retry state.
This report may already have been received. Closing cannot recall it and discards the same-report retry state.
Verification expired before acceptance. The same frozen report is ready; retry with a fresh verification.
The relay is rate limiting submissions. The same frozen report is ready; retry explicitly later with fresh verification.
The relay rejected this report ID because its content differs. It cannot be resent; edit to start a new report.
The relay rejected this report. It cannot be resent; edit to prepare a new report.

This screen was interrupted during submission. The report may already have reached the relay. The frozen same-ID report remains ready for a fresh verification and explicit retry; no background retry was made.
This screen was interrupted. Pending capture or verification was cancelled; the report was not submitted by this action.
Check the export consent box before preparing a file. Nothing has been saved.
Report preparation is unavailable. Your note is still here.
Choose a file destination. Cancelling the picker saves nothing.
The document picker is unavailable. Nothing was saved. Retry or edit your report.
No destination chosen; nothing was saved. Retry uses the same approved report.
Saving the approved JSON. Once the destination is confirmed, leaving this form cannot undo a write already started.
JSON saved. It has NOT been sent to the developer. Share the chosen file yourself if you wish.
Could not finish saving; a partial file may remain at the chosen destination. Retry to choose a destination again, or edit your report.
